†The “
total treasury return
” posted (between
3.36%
and
3.71%
) is not the DGVXX 7-day yield. It is an annualized compounded number based on the current 7-day yield for the BNY Dreyfus Government Cash Management Fund (
DGVXX
) (
3.31%
) and the additional return provided by Brex. It assumes (1) the yield remains static and (2) all dividends and distributions are reinvested for one year.
The additional-return rate is a Brex-set nominal rate based on your applicable balance tier. It is an annualized, compounded figure. If additional returns are not held for one year, the realized return will be lower than the displayed rate. Your tier is determined daily based on your total Brex balance across
Checking, Treasury, and Vault
. It may change as that balance changes. Brex may also change the tier schedule at any time. Actual payouts are calculated daily and may be lower or higher.
The total return shown is an annualized estimate. It assumes the current DGVXX yield and your applicable additional-return rate remain unchanged for one year. It also assumes monthly payouts are reinvested. Actual returns will vary because fund yields, your balance tier, and your Treasury balance may change. Additional return is calculated daily and paid monthly on funds invested in Treasury. More information can be found
here
.
DGVXX yields fluctuate daily. Past yields are not indicative of future yields. If dividends and additional returns are not held for one year, the realized return will be lower. The realized return can also decrease if rates fall.
The posted rate applies to customers eligible for the highest-tier rate on their Brex business account. Yield and additional return are variable. They are earned only on invested Treasury funds. They are calculated daily, provided monthly, and automatically reinvested.
Investing in securities involves risk, including the risk of loss. An investment in DGVXX is not a bank deposit. The FDIC and other government agencies do not insure or guarantee it. The fund seeks to preserve each share’s value at $1.00. It cannot guarantee that value, and you may lose money.
